prompt: Why should people bring both curtains from a matching pair?
promptZh: 為什麼應把成對窗簾的兩幅都帶來？

options.text: So the staff can compare their patterns before cutting.
options.zh: 讓工作人員剪裁前能比對兩幅圖案。
options.whyZh: 原文說剪裁前要比較成對的圖案，即使只改一幅。

options.text: So both curtains can be cut to different lengths.
options.zh: 為了把兩幅剪成不同長度。
options.whyZh: 原文說有時只需改一幅，沒有要求剪成不同長度。

options.text: So the rod can be measured using both curtains.
options.zh: 為了用兩幅窗簾量窗簾桿。
options.whyZh: 講者說只需目標長度，未提用兩幅去量桿。

options.text: So one curtain can be kept by the staff.
options.zh: 讓工作人員留下其中一幅。
options.whyZh: 工作人員需要先比對，不是要留一幅。

explanationZh: 原文說剪裁前要比較成對的圖案，即使只改一幅。
evidence: If you have matching curtains, bring both even if only one needs work. / That lets us compare the pattern across the pair before a cut makes the change permanent.
